summary: Diffuse bilateral hazy interstitial pattern seen in the visible prior lung has largely cleared on current, with more distinct vascular markings.

findings.rationale: Prior image (partially overexposed on the right, limiting full comparison) shows a hazy, indistinct left lung with blurred vessels; current image shows clearer, sharper bronchovascular markings bilaterally, suggesting decreased pulmonary vascular congestion. Caveat: exposure/collimation differences and patient positioning limit direct comparison.
